definitions.explanation: Bags, suitcases, or packages that one carries when traveling. Can also refer to parcels or cargo.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}ちましょうか。
{荷物|にもつ}が{多|おお}いですね。
examples.english: You have a lot of luggage.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}はどこに{置|お}きますか。
examples.english: Where should I put the luggage?

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{車|くるま}に{入|い}れてください。{大|おお}きいですから、{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Please put the luggage in the car. It's big, so be careful.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{時|とき}、{荷物|にもつ}が{多|おお}すぎて{大変|たいへん}でした。{次|つぎ}からはもっと{少|すく}ない{荷物|にもつ}で{行|い}きたいです。
examples.english: When I traveled, I had too much luggage and it was tough. Next time I want to go with less luggage.

notes:
{荷物|にもつ} means luggage, baggage, or parcels - items carried when traveling or packages being transported.

COUNTER:
{個|こ} counts pieces of luggage: {荷物|にもつ}{一|いっ}{個|こ} (one piece of luggage)

COMMON TYPES:
- {手|て}{荷物|にもつ}: hand luggage, carry-on
- {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}: checked baggage
- {宅配|たくはい}{荷物|にもつ}: delivery package

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}つ: to carry luggage
- {荷物|にもつ}を{預|あず}ける: to check luggage
- {荷物|にもつ}を{受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive luggage
- {荷物|にもつ}を{置|お}く: to put down luggage

TRAVEL IN JAPAN:
Train stations have コインロッカー (coin lockers) for storing {荷物|にもつ}. Luggage delivery services ({宅配便|たくはいびん}) can send bags ahead to your next hotel.
